scenarios.title: Take profit triggered on price recovery
scenarios.event: Position entry at 0.35, price rises to 0.45 (TP at 0.45)
scenarios.expectedAction: Detect TP condition, execute sell order, log winning trade

scenarios.title: Stop loss triggered on price decline
scenarios.event: Position entry at 0.35, price drops to 0.30 (SL at 0.30)
scenarios.expectedAction: Detect SL condition, execute sell order, log losing trade

scenarios.title: Show trading statistics after multiple trades
scenarios.event: User asks for win rate and P&L after 10 trades
scenarios.expectedAction: Calculate and display win rate, total P&L, average hold time

scenarios.title: Max position limit reached
scenarios.event: User tries to add position when at max_positions
scenarios.expectedAction: Reject new position, report current position count vs limit

scenarios.title: Price gaps through both TP and SL simultaneously
scenarios.event: Extreme volatility causes price to jump past both levels
scenarios.expectedAction: Execute at best available price, log actual vs expected exit price

criteria: TP/SL calculated correctly from entry + delta: Does the skill compute exit prices accurately?
Exit orders triggered at threshold: Does the skill detect and execute at TP/SL levels?
Win rate tracked accurately: Does the skill correctly categorize wins/losses and compute win rate?
Position limits enforced: Does the skill prevent exceeding max_positions?
State persisted for monitoring restarts: Does the skill save and restore position state?
